name: Trouble and Also Violets
author: Lonely Taco
bootlegger: Players receive two roles: one Trouble Brewing and one Sects & Violets
TB and SNV games run concurrently with completely independent and isolated game states (e.g., Fortune Teller does not register the SNV demon, Vortox does not affect TB information)
Only one of the Demons kills at night, the Storyteller chooses which Demon kill to resolve each night (i.e., for balance or Demons target one another)
If a player is executed or killed in one game, they die in both games
If a player is protected from death, then they are protected from death in both games (e.g., Monk and Soldier abilities)
The game result and grim reveal is not announced until BOTH games end (e.g., the Saint is executed in TB, or the SNV Demon is executed)
A player cannot start as both Trouble Brewing and Sects & Violets Demons, but they can end up as both Demons (i.e., Imp starpass, Fang Gu jumps, Scarlet Woman catches)

If a player is both the Fang Gu and the Imp, Fang Gu jumps count as a starpass for the Imp. However, if the Fang Gu + Imp player decides kill themselves and starpass, the Fang Gu would die and end the SNV game immediately
Pit Hag Demon changes can still cause arbitrary deaths
